decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Existing Location and Block Plan E00 Dated 20.03.2026;Existing Drawings Floor Plans E01 Dated 20.03.2026;Existing Drawings Elevations E02 Dated 20.03.2026;Existing Drawings Elevation E03 Dated 20.03.2026;Existing Drawings Sections E04 Dated 20.03.2026;Proposed Location and Block Plan P00 Dated 06.05.2026;Proposed Drawings Site Plan P01 Dated 11.05.2026;Proposed Drawings Floor Plans P02 Dated 11.05.2026;Proposed Drawings Elevations P03 Dated 11.05.2026;Proposed Drawings Elevations P04 Dated 11.05.2026;Proposed Drawings Sections P05 Dated 11.05.2026;Proposed Drawings Details P06 Dated 11.05.2026;Proposed Drawings Details P07 Dated 11.05.2026;Flood Risk Assessment May 2026;SUDS Pro Forma;Highway Safety Impact Form.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than six residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect neighbouring residential amenity or the character of the immediate area.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen and dining/living rooms shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Prior to first occupation of the HMO, an additional rooflight shall be installed above the ground-floor communal kitchen/dining room in accordance with details that have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The rooflight shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To improve natural light to the communal living accommodation and secure an acceptable standard of residential amenity for future occupiers.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site have been provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained permanently thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the amenity of the occupiers of adjoining premises; protect the general environment; prevent any obstruction to pedestrian movement and to ensure that there are adequate facilities for the storage and recycling of recoverable materials.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

Prior to first occupation of the HMO hereby approved, the flood resilience measures, raised threshold arrangements, and flood warning and evacuation measures set out in the submitted Flood Risk Assessment shall be implemented in full and retained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure that future occupiers are appropriately protected from flood risk, having regard to the site's identified surface water and fluvial flood risk, in accordance with London Plan Policy SI12 and Policies DMD59, DMD60 and DMD61 of the Development Management Document.
description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class C4 (HMO-house in multiple occupation) involving rear dormer, outrigger dormer with front rooflights and associated amenity, cycle and refuse storage.
